attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Elias knelt in the frost, his hands trembling as he smoothed the stiff fabric of his mother’s coat.","severity":"major","reason":"Places Elias with her body in the passes, an event the briefing never mentions; the caravan was lost."},{"span":"the letter she had clutched until her final breath","severity":"minor","reason":"Embellishes the letter into a deathbed detail the briefing does not give."},{"span":"the blizzard still howling","severity":"minor","reason":"Has the blizzard still going at this moment, which the briefing does not say."},{"span":"He would pack the remaining supplies","severity":"minor","reason":"Implies supplies survived the loss of the caravan."}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"The scene is clear, ends firmly on the heir's intent, and the grease-stained sleeve nicely evokes the engineer.
